_howto: Elections polled by the Alaska Division of Elections adapter (server/src/adapters/akdoe.js). electionId = the id in https://www.elections.alaska.gov/election-results/e/?id={id} (upper case in the file path); the page links {base}/enr/{ID}/results/GA_ENR_Precinct_State_of_Alaska.csv, the precinct-level results of every contest. Alaska has no counties: statewide only. Ranked-choice contests are first-choice counts. Set enabled:false to stop polling.
_contestRulesHowto: Contest-name rules for this source, tried before the shared config/contest-rules.json.

contestRules.note: AK: state senate seats are lettered (Senate District A..T)
